exact_claim_text: Within the synthetic accounts, uncertainty is managed through repeated switching between code inspection, data checks and external reassurance, with negative cases showing deliberate refusal of automated suggestions.
method_or_source: Constant comparison across accounts, deliberate search for negative cases and reflexive comparison between early and revised interpretations.
uncertainty: Synthetic accounts, interpretive dependence, sampling boundary and absence of real participant validation.
boundary: Illustrative purposive sample in one teaching context; no statistical prevalence claim and no case-study claim.
counter_evidence_or_alternative: Several negative cases reject automated suggestions and use independent reconstruction before acceptance.
stronger_wording_rejected: Novice analysts generally trust automated notebook outputs.
